name: 感觉检索 · 美术对照表
name_zh: 感觉检索 · 美术对照表
description: Turn one colloquial sentence about a mood into the best-matching visual style, with the feeling words that triggered it and reference images.
description_zh: 输入一句口语化的感觉描述，检索出最匹配的视觉风格，并给出触发它的感受词、风格定义与参考图。适合美术定调、AI 绘画提示词与概念设计。
description_en: Turn one colloquial sentence about a mood into the best-matching visual style from a Chinese art-reference lexicon, with the feeling words that triggered it, a one-line definition and reference images.
examples_zh: 帮我找一种适合「雨夜便利店冷白灯光」的画风
这种感觉在美术上叫什么：孤独、安静、街头霓虹
给一个赛博朋克但不要太吵的方案，要湿冷、克制
examples_en: Find an art style for a rainy night outside a convenience store
What is the art term for lonely, quiet, neon-lit streets
A cyberpunk look that is wet and restrained, not loud
